about: Test vectors of the optional ssh public key (SSH-KEY.PUB) rule, shared by the page (web/site/js/sshkey.js, web/test/unit/sshkey.test.mjs) and the installer's Go tests. Made by web/test/unit/sshkey-vectors.py with throwaway keys (ssh-keygen); every key here is a test key. valid: the rule accepts the input. For a valid input: type, bits and fingerprint (from ssh-keygen -l -E sha256), line (the normalised line) and file (the bytes SSH-KEY.PUB gets: line + LF). ssh_keygen_l: what ssh-keygen -l prints for the input as a file (null: ssh-keygen refused it); information only, the rule is stricter. why: what the vector tests.

vectors.name: ed25519-comment-64
vectors.why: a comment of 64 characters of the whole allowed set

vectors.name: rsa-3072
vectors.why: a real 3072-bit rsa key (the lower bound)

vectors.name: rsa-4096
vectors.why: a real 4096-bit rsa key, trailing LF

vectors.name: rsa-16384
vectors.why: n of 16384 bits (the upper bound; a synthetic n)

vectors.name: rsa-4001
vectors.why: n of 4001 bits: its top byte is 0x01, so its mpint has no leading 0x00 (synthetic n)

vectors.name: two-lf
vectors.why: two trailing LFs (a second, empty line)

vectors.name: double-space
vectors.why: two spaces between type and key

vectors.name: options-command-space
vectors.why: an options prefix with a quoted space

vectors.name: comment-quote
vectors.why: a comment with a double quote

vectors.name: comment-squote
vectors.why: a comment with a single quote

vectors.name: comment-non-ascii
vectors.why: a comment with a non-ASCII letter

vectors.name: b64-noncanonical
vectors.why: non-zero unused bits before the padding (decodes to the same bytes)

vectors.name: b64-length
vectors.why: a length that is not a multiple of 4

vectors.name: ed25519-trailing-garbage
vectors.why: one byte after the ed25519 blob

vectors.name: ed25519-trailing-string
vectors.why: a string after the ed25519 blob

vectors.name: ed25519-truncated
vectors.why: the blob cut short by one byte

vectors.name: ed25519-len-overflow
vectors.why: a length field larger than the blob

vectors.name: type-mismatch-rsa-ed
vectors.why: line says ssh-rsa, blob is ssh-ed25519

vectors.name: type-mismatch-ed-rsa
vectors.why: line says ssh-ed25519, blob is ssh-rsa

vectors.name: blob-type-nul
vectors.why: the blob's type has a NUL

vectors.name: rsa-n-leading-zero
vectors.why: n with a superfluous 0x00 (top bit of the next byte clear)

vectors.name: rsa-n-negative
vectors.why: n with the top bit set and no 0x00 (negative)

vectors.name: rsa-trailing-garbage
vectors.why: an empty string after the rsa blob

vectors.name: rsa-trailing-byte
vectors.why: one byte after the rsa blob

vectors.name: rsa-sha2-512-type
vectors.why: a signature name as the type

b3BlbnNzaC1rZXktdjEAAAAA
